name: Cumbia bajo walkup
desc: Cumbia sonidera bass in Eb major: warm triangle roots landing 1 and 3 with the fifth answering, and a cheeky four-note walkup turning every fourth bar — the bajo that makes abuelas dance. Peak syncopates into the and-of-4 anticipation.

code.full: note("<[eb2 ~ ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ ~] [eb2 ~ ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ ~] [ab1 ~ ~ ~ eb2 ~ ~ ~] [bb1 ~ eb2 f2 g2 ~ ab2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").attack(.01).decay(.35).sustain(.38).release(.18).shape(.45).lpf(sine.range(550,900).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb2 ~ ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ eb2] [eb2 ~ ~ ~ bb1 ~ ~ g2] [ab1 ~ ~ ab2 eb2 ~ ~ c2] [bb1 ~ eb2 f2 g2 ab2 bb2 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").attack(.008).decay(.3).sustain(.35).release(.15).shape(.5).lpf(900).gain(${gain}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
